covered_report_window: U.S.-listed companies reporting after the 4:00 p.m. ET U.S. market close on Friday, October 9, 2026, plus companies reporting before the 9:30 a.m. ET U.S. market open on Monday, October 12, 2026.
market_context_summary: U.S. equities were higher intraday on Friday during a record-setting week, while elevated and volatile Treasury yields, oil and Iran-related headlines remained the dominant macro risks. Monday is an equity-market session, but banks and the U.S. bond market are closed. No U.S.-listed company passed the confirmed-timing, liquidity and evidence-quality gates for this immediate window.

top_setups.note: No evidence-qualified U.S.-listed reporter existed in the strict actionable window, so there are no top-three setups.

methodology.independence_note: The shared-universe screen produced zero qualified tickers. Passes A, B and C therefore each evaluated the same empty universe; no scores or conclusions were fabricated.
methodology.disparity_definition: A 0-to-100 measure of dispersion across the three independent direction-score and reversal-risk assessments; lower means tighter agreement. It is not applicable when no company is scored.
methodology.learned_lessons_update: No scoring-method change. The existing timing-confirmation, listing-status, liquidity and evidence-quality guardrails were sufficient.

universe_exclusions.calendar_timing: October 9 after close on secondary calendars
universe_exclusions.reason: Excluded before scoring: stale symbol/listing entry. The issuer entered Chapter 11 and moved from Nasdaq to OTC under CLSDQ; OTC and bankruptcy remnants are outside scope.

universe_exclusions.company: UNTY, ACZT, ALDS, BMRA, BZYR, DYNT, FNGR, HFUS, HWNI, LQMT, NAAS, NGTF, NRIS, QNME, SOND, STME
universe_exclusions.reason: Excluded before scoring: none had confirmed before-open timing. Higher-quality calendars showed no Monday before-open earnings events.

research_allocation_view.why_unallocated: No company met the prerequisite for consensus scoring, so no name could satisfy the direction-score, reversal-risk, confidence and evidence-quality allocation tests.
research_allocation_view.plain_statement: This is a research prioritization model, not financial advice.

disclaimer_text: This is research, not financial advice. Earnings reactions are highly uncertain and can be driven by market positioning, guidance, macro conditions, and management commentary rather than reported results alone.
